![](https://www.spacepower.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Log3.png)
![](https://www.spacepower.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/hangar_upgrade_epic.jpg)

Use this blender to upgrade a rare Spaceship Hangar NFT to the epic Spaceship Hangar NFT.

Ingredients:
🔥Artefact NFT (rare)
🔥Spaceship Hangar NFT (rare)
🔥Artefact NFT (epic)
🔥Elerium NFT

❗️During the blending, when you receive the result NFT, your ingredients NFTs will be automatically burned.🔥
